about_the_game:
交流组队群：481243717

New coop-game product positioning: Theatrical Party Game

Online multiplayer gameplay: Tabletop-style DM + Scripted Roleplay + Co-op/Competitive Mini-Games

You can complete the game with your friends in 3 hours and have a definite fun! Play in the afternoon and have dinner together after the game!

2.5D viewing angle to prevent 3D dizziness

The camera is orthogonal at 30 degrees downwards, and the camera rotates fixedly at 45 degrees (in four directions). Even those who are dizzy with 3D can play it!

Easy to get started

The game can be completed with 7 keyboard keys + mouse, everything is designed to be easy!

3 Story Players: Traditional RPG Gameplay

Have conversations, get information, make decisions, get rewards, and advance the plot: it's that simple!

1 Player with a destiny: a new way to play as a director

The Destiny Keeper, also known as the Director, God, or Dungeon Master, holds godlike powers that must not be revealed lightly. The Destiny Keeper can take on the roles of various NPCs within the game world to interact with story players. Their goal is to act as an observer—adjusting and guiding the flow to provide the best possible experience for others. At the end of the game, other players will rate the Destiny Keeper's performance, allowing them to take part in the final MVP selection.

Simplified all-in-one system: Character Status Item System(CSIS)

A multifunctional system that integrates character equipment, backpack, BUFF bar, and task log! Say goodbye to the complicated opening and closing of multiple interfaces, all information is in front of you!

Mini-game: confrontation and cooperation

Interspersed in the storyline, it draws on the essence of multiplayer online party games, focusing on simple design, easy to use, strong interaction, and high fun!

Stylized hand-painted graphics

3D modeling + hand-painted textures + 3D rendering, dedicated to reproducing the cultural world of the Three Kingdoms at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty.

short_description: Chaos rises as the empire crumbles. Fuxi sends a Destiny Executor to guide a new ruler. A century after failure, Liu Bei is chosen—not by force, but by virtue. Play as the Executor, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei. Shape fate through your choices in this new tale of the Three Kingdoms.
